description: This is a test class for the BuzzDao class, specifically testing methods that adjust like and comment counts on social media-like shares and comments within the OrangeHRM Buzz plugin. It sets up test data and verifies the correctness of count adjustments through assertions.

classes.name: BuzzDaoAdjustCountTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the behavior of BuzzDao methods related to adjusting like and comment counts on share and comment entities within the Buzz plugin.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test data by loading a YAML fixture into the database before each test.

methods.name: testAdjustLikeAndCommentCountsOnShares
methods.description: Tests the method that updates the like and comment counts on shared posts, verifying that the counts match expected values after adjustment.

methods.name: testAdjustLikeCountOnComments
methods.description: Tests the method responsible for adjusting the like counts on individual comments, ensuring the counts are correctly updated.
